description: Conjecture that for any algebraically closed field F of characteristic 0, any integer k ≥ 2, and any nonzero polynomial n ∈ F[x], a set A ⊂ F[x] with the property that ab + n is a k-th power in F[x] for all distinct a,b ∈ A has cardinality at most 6, unless n is simultaneously a square and a k-th power and A consists of constant multiples of the square root of n.
proof_strategy: Adapt the determinant criterion and Mason–Stothers generalization used for k ≥ 18 to lower k by incorporating additional symmetry arguments and applying the Combinatorial Nullstellensatz to control degrees; reduce to the constant case via specialization and use known bounds for classical Diophantine tuples over algebraically closed fields.
title: Absolute bound for generalized Diophantine tuples over polynomial rings for all k ≥ 2

description: For every positive integer r there exists a periodic recipe σ (i.e., a finite permutation of {1,…,p} for some p) such that the asymptotic ratio μ_r(σ) equals 1.
proof_strategy: constructive combinatorial design using balanced permutations
title: Existence of Recipes with Unit Ratio for any r

description: In the constructed ternary word via the morphism μ: Σ₃* → Σ₃* (with C = cbbbc), any parameterized square of length ≥ 2ℓ must satisfy u = v under the given parameterization.
proof_strategy: Structural induction on the morphism's iteration depth, verifying that any parameterized square of sufficient length inherits the standard square property through the morphism's constraints.
title: All ℓ^+ parameterized squares in the morphically constructed ternary word are standard squares
